newsitem.title: USA: Hauppauge Digital sees Q1 sales of $6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hauppauge Digital sees Q1 sales of $6 mln.

text.p: Hauppauge Digital Inc said it expects to report sales of more than $6 million in its first fiscal quarter ended December 31, compared with sales of $4.5 million in the year-earlier period.
The company did not say how the increased sales would affect its earnings for the period.
Officials at the company were not immediately available to comment.
The increase stems from strong worldwide demand for Win/TV and WinCast/TV products, the company said. It also includes new OEM shipments of video conferencing boards.
